<hr>
<h2 id="1-概述">1. 概述</h2>
<h3 id="11-什么是-superpowers">1.1 什么是 Superpowers？</h3>
<p><strong>Superpowers</strong> 是一套 Claude Code 插件技能集，专注于<strong>软件工程方法论的系统化</strong>。它将 TDD（测试驱动开发）、代码审查、系统调试等工程实践编码为可复用的 AI 工作流，确保 AI 编码助手遵循严格的工程纪律。</p>
<p><strong>核心理念：</strong> 用规则约束 AI 行为，防止"快速但低质量"的代码输出。</p>
<h3 id="12-什么是-gstack">1.2 什么是 gstack？</h3>
<p><strong>gstack</strong> 是一套全生命周期项目管理技能集，覆盖从产品构思到部署监控的完整开发流程。它提供 QA 测试、代码审查、设计审查、部署验证等自动化工作流。</p>
<p><strong>核心理念：</strong> "Boil the Ocean"（把海水煮沸）— 既然 AI 边际成本趋近于零，就把每件事做到极致完整。</p>
<h3 id="13-为什么要结合使用">1.3 为什么要结合使用？</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1724295/202606/1724295-20260625133922535-265158490.png" alt="01-efficiency-quadrant" loading="lazy"></p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>维度</th>
<th>Superpowers 贡献</th>
<th>gstack 贡献</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>规划</td>
<td>设计文档 + 实施计划模板</td>
<td>CEO/工程/设计多维审查</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>实现</td>
<td>TDD + 子代理驱动开发</td>
<td>自动化测试 + 浏览器 QA</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>审查</td>
<td>代码审查协议</td>
<td>多维审查军团 + 安全扫描</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>部署</td>
<td>完成分支管理</td>
<td>Ship + 部署 + 金丝雀监控</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>质量</td>
<td>验证即完成</td>
<td>设计审查 + 可访问性审计</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h3 id="22-安装-superpowers">2.2 安装 Superpowers</h3>
<p>Superpowers 作为 Claude Code 插件安装：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 方法一：通过 Claude Code 插件市场安装（推荐）
claude plugins:install superpowers

# 方法二：手动安装
cd ~/.claude/plugins
git clone https://github.com/anthropics/superpowers.git

# 验证安装
claude skills:list | grep superpowers
</code></pre>
<p>安装完成后，技能文件位于：</p>
<pre><code>~/.claude/plugins/cache/superpowers/superpowers/&lt;version&gt;/skills/
├── brainstorming/SKILL.md
├── dispatching-parallel-agents/SKILL.md
├── executing-plans/SKILL.md
├── finishing-a-development-branch/SKILL.md
├── receiving-code-review/SKILL.md
├── requesting-code-review/SKILL.md
├── subagent-driven-development/SKILL.md
├── systematic-debugging/SKILL.md
├── test-driven-development/SKILL.md
├── using-git-worktrees/SKILL.md
├── using-superpowers/SKILL.md
├── verification-before-completion/SKILL.md
├── writing-plans/SKILL.md
└── writing-skills/SKILL.md
</code></pre>
<h3 id="23-安装-gstack">2.3 安装 gstack</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 方法一：通过 setup 脚本安装（推荐）
cd ~/.claude/skills
git clone https://github.com/garryslist/gstack.git
cd gstack &amp;&amp; ./setup

# 方法二：如果已有 Claude Code 环境，直接运行
cd ~/.claude/skills/gstack &amp;&amp; ./setup --team

# 验证安装
ls ~/.claude/skills/gstack/SKILL.md
</code></pre>
<p>gstack 安装后的目录结构：</p>
<pre><code>~/.claude/skills/gstack/
├── SKILL.md              # 主入口技能
├── bin/                  # CLI 工具集
├── browse/              # 无头浏览器引擎
├── sections/            # 各子流程详细步骤
└── ...

~/.claude/skills/         # gstack 子技能（独立目录）
├── spec/
├── ship/
├── qa/
├── investigate/
├── review/
├── design-review/
├── context-save/
├── context-restore/
├── autoplan/
├── office-hours/
├── land-and-deploy/
├── canary/
├── dev-workflow/
└── ...
</code></pre>
<h3 id="24-配置-claudemd-路由规则">2.4 配置 CLAUDE.md 路由规则</h3>
<p>安装完成后，在项目根目录的 <code>CLAUDE.md</code> 中添加技能路由：</p>
<pre><code class="language-markdown">## Skill routing

When the user's request matches an available skill, invoke it via the Skill tool.

Key routing rules:
- 产品创意/头脑风暴     → /office-hours
- 策略/范围    → /plan-ceo-review
- 架构      → /plan-eng-review
- 设计系统/计划审查     → /design-consultation 或 /plan-design-review
- 全流程审查      → /autoplan
- Bug/错误     → /investigate
- QA/测试行为     → /qa 或 /qa-only
- 代码审查/diff 检查    → /review
- 视觉优化     → /design-review
- 发布/部署/PR    → /ship 或 /land-and-deploy
- 保存进度     → /context-save
- 恢复上下文      → /context-restore
- 撰写规格文档    → /spec
</code></pre>

<h2 id="3-superpowers-技能详解">3. Superpowers 技能详解</h2>
<h3 id="31-技能总览">3.1 技能总览</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1724295/202606/1724295-20260625141542779-633063240.png" alt="03-superpowers-skills" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="32-各技能详细说明">3.2 各技能详细说明</h3>
<h4 id="321-brainstorming头脑风暴">3.2.1 brainstorming（头脑风暴）</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>属性</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>用途</strong></td>
<td>在任何创意性工作之前进行需求探索和设计</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>触发</strong></td>
<td>新功能、新组件、行为变更</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>硬性规则</strong></td>
<td>设计批准前禁止任何实现代码</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>工作流：</strong></p>
<pre><code>探索项目上下文 → 逐一提问（单选题优先）→ 提出2-3个方案 → 分段展示设计 → 用户逐段批准 → 写入设计文档 → 过渡到 writing-plans
</code></pre>
<p><strong>使用示例：</strong></p>
<pre><code>用户: 我想给系统加一个通知中心
AI: [调用 brainstorming] 让我先了解一下需求...
    1. 通知中心主要服务哪些用户？
    A) 内部运营  B) 终端用户  C) 两者都有
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 id="322-writing-plans编写计划">3.2.2 writing-plans（编写计划）</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>属性</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>用途</strong></td>
<td>将需求/设计文档转化为可执行的实施计划</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>触发</strong></td>
<td>有了 spec 或需求，准备开始编码之前</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>硬性规则</strong></td>
<td>禁止占位符（TBD、"类似任务N"等）</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>计划文件结构：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-markdown"># 实施计划: [功能名称]

## Header
- Goal: [目标]
- Architecture: [架构描述]
- Tech Stack: [技术栈]
- Global Constraints: [全局约束]

## Task 1: [任务名]
### Step 1.1: Write failing test
- File: `src/tests/feature.test.ts`
- Expected: RED (test fails)
- Command: `npm test -- --grep "feature"`
- Expected output: "1 failing"

### Step 1.2: Implement minimal code
- File: `src/feature.ts`
- Expected: GREEN (test passes)
...
</code></pre>
<p><strong>保存位置：</strong> <code>docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-&lt;feature-name&gt;.md</code></p>
<hr>
<h4 id="323-test-driven-development测试驱动开发">3.2.3 test-driven-development（测试驱动开发）</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>属性</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>用途</strong></td>
<td>所有新功能、Bug 修复、重构的实现方法</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>触发</strong></td>
<td>任何代码变更</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>铁律</strong></td>
<td>没有失败测试，不写生产代码</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>Red-Green-Refactor 循环：</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1724295/202606/1724295-20260625134306487-371384909.png" alt="06-tdd-cycle" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>关键规则：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>先写测试 → 运行确认失败（必须看到红色）</li>
<li>写最小代码 → 运行确认通过（必须看到绿色）</li>
<li>重构 → 保持测试通过</li>
<li>在测试之前写的代码 = 删除重来</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h4 id="324-systematic-debugging系统化调试">3.2.4 systematic-debugging（系统化调试）</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>属性</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>用途</strong></td>
<td>任何 Bug、测试失败、异常行为的调查</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>触发</strong></td>
<td>报错、异常、"为什么不工作"</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>铁律</strong></td>
<td>不找到根因不修复</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>四阶段流程：</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1724295/202606/1724295-20260625134317692-424934780.png" alt="07-debugging-phases" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>三振出局规则：</strong> 3次修复尝试失败 → 停止并质疑架构</p>
<hr>
<h4 id="325-subagent-driven-development子代理驱动开发">3.2.5 subagent-driven-development（子代理驱动开发）</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>属性</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>用途</strong></td>
<td>将计划中的任务分派给独立子代理执行</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>触发</strong></td>
<td>有计划、任务相对独立、需要并行</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>关键</strong></td>
<td>每个任务一个代理 + 任务审查 + 全分支审查</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>执行模式：</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1724295/202606/1724295-20260625134337552-1540975206.png" alt="09-subagent-model" loading="lazy"></p>
<hr>
<h4 id="326-verification-before-completion完成前验证">3.2.6 verification-before-completion（完成前验证）</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>属性</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>用途</strong></td>
<td>任何"完成"声明之前的强制验证</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>触发</strong></td>
<td>准备说"Done"、"Fixed"、"Passing"</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>铁律</strong></td>
<td>没有新鲜的验证证据，不声明完成</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>门控函数：</strong></p>
<pre><code>识别证明命令 → 运行完整命令 → 读取完整输出 → 验证输出支持声明 → 才能声明
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 id="327-其他技能速查">3.2.7 其他技能速查</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>技能</th>
<th>一句话说明</th>
<th>何时使用</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><code>using-superpowers</code></td>
<td>技能调度总控，确保正确技能被调用</td>
<td>每次对话开始</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>dispatching-parallel-agents</code></td>
<td>将独立任务并行分派给多个代理</td>
<td>3+ 独立故障</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>executing-plans</code></td>
<td>在当前会话中逐步执行计划</td>
<td>无子代理时</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>finishing-a-development-branch</code></td>
<td>分支完成后的合并/PR/清理</td>
<td>实现完毕</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>requesting-code-review</code></td>
<td>派遣审查子代理做代码审查</td>
<td>每个任务完成后</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>receiving-code-review</code></td>
<td>处理审查反馈的协议</td>
<td>收到审查意见</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>using-git-worktrees</code></td>
<td>创建隔离工作空间</td>
<td>开始新功能</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><code>writing-skills</code></td>
<td>用 TDD 方法编写新技能</td>
<td>创建/编辑技能</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h2 id="4-gstack-技能详解">4. gstack 技能详解</h2>
<h3 id="41-技能总览">4.1 技能总览</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1724295/202606/1724295-20260625141628820-2126565657.png" alt="04-gstack-skills" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="42-核心技能详细说明">4.2 核心技能详细说明</h3>
<h4 id="421-office-hours产品构思">4.2.1 /office-hours（产品构思）</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>属性</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>用途</strong></td>
<td>YC 式产品办公时间，探索产品方向</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>触发</strong></td>
<td>"我有个想法"、"这个值得做吗"、"帮我想想"</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>输出</strong></td>
<td>设计文档（非代码）</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>两种模式：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Startup Mode</strong>：六大逼问（需求真实性、现状、紧迫性、最窄切入点...）</li>
<li><strong>Builder Mode</strong>：生成式、鼓励性探索</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>使用示例：</strong></p>
<pre><code>用户: /office-hours 我想做一个 AI 驱动的客服机器人
AI: [启动 Startup Mode]
    让我问第一个问题：
    谁正在急迫地为这个问题付费或忍受痛苦？
    能否描述一个具体的用户和他们今天是怎么应对的？
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h4 id="422-spec规格文档">4.2.2 /spec（规格文档）</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>属性</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>用途</strong></td>
<td>将模糊意图变为精确、可执行的规格</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>触发</strong></td>
<td>"写个 ticket"、"提个 issue"、"规格化"</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>输出</strong></td>
<td>GitHub Issue</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>五阶段流程：</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1724295/202606/1724295-20260625134337552-1540975206.png" alt="09-subagent-model" loading="lazy"></p>
<hr>
<h4 id="423-qaqa-测试">4.2.3 /qa（QA 测试）</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>属性</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>用途</strong></td>
<td>系统化 QA 测试 Web 应用并修复 Bug</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>触发</strong></td>
<td>"测试一下"、"QA"、"有没有 bug"</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>三层深度</strong></td>
<td>Quick / Standard / Exhaustive</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>工作流：</strong></p>
<pre><code>初始化 → 认证 → 定向 → 逐页探索 → 截图取证 → 健康评分 → 分诊
→ 修复循环（定位→修复→提交→回测）→ 最终 QA → 报告
</code></pre>
<p><strong>关键特性：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>使用无头浏览器（不看源码，以用户视角测试）</li>
<li>每个修复一个原子提交</li>
<li>回归时自动 revert</li>
<li>每个 Issue 必须有截图证据</li>
<li>硬限 50 个修复</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h4 id="424-investigatebug-调查">4.2.4 /investigate（Bug 调查）</h4>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>属性</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>用途</strong></td>
<td>系统化根因调查</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>触发</strong></td>
<td>"为什么坏了"、"debug"、"根因分析"</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>铁律</strong></td>
<td>不找到根因不修复</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>与 Superpowers 的 systematic-debugging 完全互补：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Superpowers 提供方法论框架</li>
<li>gstack <code>/investigate</code> 提供工具支持（浏览器、代码搜索、学习记录等）</li>
</ul>

<h4 id="429-context-save--context-restore上下文管理">4.2.9 /context-save &amp; /context-restore（上下文管理）</h4>
<pre><code>/context-save:  保存当前 git 状态 + 决策 + 剩余工作 → 检查点文件
/context-restore: 加载最近检查点 → 恢复工作上下文
</code></pre>
<p><strong>使用场景：</strong> 切换分支、会话超时、跨天工作</p>

<h3 id="53-典型结合场景">5.3 典型结合场景</h3>
<p><strong>场景 1：新功能开发</strong></p>
<pre><code>1. /office-hours              ← gstack 产品探索
2. /brainstorming             ← Superpowers 设计先行
3. /writing-plans             ← Superpowers 编写计划
4. /autoplan                  ← gstack 全维度审查
5. /using-git-worktrees       ← Superpowers 创建隔离环境
6. /TDD (Red-Green-Refactor)  ← Superpowers 驱动实现
7. /requesting-code-review    ← Superpowers 派遣审查代理
8. /review                    ← gstack 审查军团
9. /verification              ← Superpowers 验证证据
10. /ship                     ← gstack 发布
11. /land-and-deploy          ← gstack 部署
12. /canary                   ← gstack 监控
</code></pre>
<p><strong>场景 2：Bug 修复</strong></p>
<pre><code>1. /investigate               ← gstack 工具辅助调查
2. /systematic-debugging      ← Superpowers 方法论约束
3. /TDD (先写失败测试)         ← Superpowers 确保质量
4. /verification              ← Superpowers 验证修复
5. /ship                      ← gstack 发布
</code></pre>
<p><strong>场景 3：代码审查</strong></p>
<pre><code>1. /requesting-code-review    ← Superpowers 生成审查请求
2. /review                    ← gstack 执行多维审查
3. /receiving-code-review     ← Superpowers 处理反馈协议
</code></pre>

<h2 id="6-通用开发流程">6. 通用开发流程</h2>
<h3 id="61-完整流程图">6.1 完整流程图</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1724295/202606/1724295-20260625134327989-19120679.png" alt="08-full-workflow" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="62-阶段门控条件">6.2 阶段门控条件</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>阶段</th>
<th>门控条件（必须满足才能进入下一阶段）</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>构思 → 规划</td>
<td>设计文档已写入并获用户批准</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>规划 → 隔离</td>
<td>计划通过 autoplan 审查</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>隔离 → 实现</td>
<td>工作树创建成功、测试基线通过</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>实现 → 审查</td>
<td>所有任务完成、测试通过</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>审查 → 验证</td>
<td>Critical 全修复、Important 全修复</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>验证 → 发布</td>
<td>QA 通过、验证证据收集完毕</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>发布 → 部署</td>
<td>PR 创建成功、CI 通过</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>部署 → 完成</td>
<td>金丝雀监控 HEALTHY</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="63-快速通道">6.3 快速通道</h3>
<p>对于简单任务，可跳过部分阶段：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>任务复杂度</th>
<th>跳过的阶段</th>
<th>保留的阶段</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>Typo/Config</strong> (&lt; 5 行)</td>
<td>构思、规划、隔离、审查军团</td>
<td>TDD、验证、发布</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>Bug Fix</strong> (已知根因)</td>
<td>构思</td>
<td>/investigate 确认→计划→实现→全流程</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>Hotfix</strong> (紧急修复)</td>
<td>构思、规划、隔离、金丝雀</td>
<td>TDD→验证→直接发布到 main</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>Feature</strong> (新功能)</td>
<td>无跳过</td>
<td>完整流程</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<pre><code>
---

## 7. 通用开发流程 Skill

以下是一个可直接使用的通用开发流程 Skill，结合了 Superpowers 和 gstack 的最佳实践：

```markdown
---
name: dev-workflow
description: &gt;
  Full-cycle development workflow combining Superpowers discipline with gstack
  tooling. Use when starting a non-trivial feature, refactor, or fix that needs
  structured planning and verification. NOT for typos, trivial config, or pure
  research.
triggers:
  - new feature
  - start working on
  - build
  - implement
  - full workflow
  - 新功能
  - 开始开发
  - 完整流程
---

# Dev Workflow: Superpowers + gstack

## Stage Overview

8 gated stages. Each has a GATE condition — do not advance without meeting it.

## Stage 1: CLASSIFY

Determine task type and select the appropriate path:

| Type | Criteria | Path |
|------|----------|------|
| Trivial | &lt; 10 lines, no behavior change | → Stage 4 (skip brainstorm/plan) |
| Bug Fix | Known symptoms, needs investigation | → /investigate → Stage 4 |
| Feature | New functionality or major refactor | → Stage 2 (full workflow) |
| Hotfix | Production-critical, time-sensitive | → Stage 4 (direct to main) |

## Stage 2: BRAINSTORM

**Tools:** Superpowers `brainstorming` + gstack `/office-hours`

1. Invoke `/office-hours` for product-level exploration
2. Apply `brainstorming` discipline:
   - Ask questions ONE at a time
   - Propose 2-3 approaches
   - Present design in sections, approve each
3. Write design doc to `docs/superpowers/specs/YYYY-MM-DD-&lt;topic&gt;-design.md`

**GATE:** Design document exists AND user has approved it.

## Stage 3: PLAN

**Tools:** Superpowers `writing-plans` + gstack `/plan-eng-review`

1. Write implementation plan following `writing-plans` rules:
   - Every step = 2-5 minutes
   - NO placeholders (TBD, "similar to...", "appropriate handling")
   - Each step: write test → run RED → implement → run GREEN → commit
2. Save to `docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-&lt;feature-name&gt;.md`
3. Run `/autoplan` for multi-dimensional review (or `/plan-eng-review` for eng-only)

**GATE:** Plan passes review (no blocking issues).

## Stage 4: ISOLATE

**Tools:** Superpowers `using-git-worktrees`

1. Check for existing isolation (native tools first)
2. Create worktree if needed: `EnterWorktree` or `git worktree add`
3. Install dependencies (auto-detect: npm/cargo/pip/go)
4. Run tests to establish clean baseline

**GATE:** Tests pass in the isolated workspace.

## Stage 5: IMPLEMENT

**Tools:** Superpowers `test-driven-development` + `subagent-driven-development`

For each task in the plan:

Rules:
- One task at a time (no batching)
- Must SEE red test output before writing implementation
- Must SEE green test output before committing
- If 3 attempts fail → STOP (systematic-debugging)

**GATE:** All tasks complete, all tests pass.

## Stage 6: REVIEW

**Tools:** Superpowers `requesting-code-review` + gstack `/review`

1. Dispatch code-reviewer subagent (Superpowers protocol)
2. Run `/review` for multi-dimensional review army
3. Process findings:
   - Critical → fix immediately
   - Important → fix before proceeding
   - Minor → note for later

**GATE:** Zero Critical/Important issues remaining.

## Stage 7: VERIFY

**Tools:** gstack `/qa` + Superpowers `verification-before-completion`

1. Run `/qa` (black-box testing via browser)
2. Apply `verification-before-completion`:
   - Identify proving command
   - Run it FRESH
   - Read FULL output
   - Confirm output proves claim
3. Collect evidence (screenshots, test output, logs)

**GATE:** QA passes + verification evidence collected.

## Stage 8: SHIP

**Tools:** gstack `/ship` + Superpowers `finishing-a-development-branch`

1. Run `/ship`:
   - Tests → Coverage → Version bump → CHANGELOG → Push → PR
2. Apply `finishing-a-development-branch`:
   - Present merge/PR/keep/discard options
   - Execute chosen path
   - Clean up worktree

**GATE:** PR created and CI green.

## Post-Ship (Optional)

- `/land-and-deploy` — merge + deploy + verify
- `/canary` — post-deploy monitoring (10 min)
- `/context-save` — save progress for cross-session work

## User Controls

| Command | Effect |
|---------|--------|
| `skip &lt;stage&gt;` | Skip a stage (with acknowledgment) |
| `back` | Return to previous stage |
| `pause` | Save context and stop |
| `abort` | Discard and clean up |

## Completion Status

- **SHIPPED** — PR created and/or deployed
- **VERIFIED** — All evidence collected, awaiting ship
- **BLOCKED** — Cannot proceed (state blocker)
- **PAUSED** — Context saved, ready to resume

</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="8-最佳实践与注意事项">8. 最佳实践与注意事项</h2>
<h3 id="81-最佳实践">8.1 最佳实践</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>#</th>
<th>实践</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>1</td>
<td>永远设计先行</td>
<td>brainstorming / office-hours 在编码之前</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>2</td>
<td>永远测试先行</td>
<td>TDD Red-Green-Refactor 不可跳过</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>3</td>
<td>永远验证完成</td>
<td>看到证据才说 Done</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>4</td>
<td>永远隔离工作</td>
<td>worktree 保护 main 分支</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>5</td>
<td>永远原子提交</td>
<td>一个修复一个 commit</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>6</td>
<td>永远找根因</td>
<td>调试时不猜测，不"先试试"</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>7</td>
<td>定期保存</td>
<td>/context-save 防止丢失进度</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>8</td>
<td>信任工具</td>
<td>让 /review 和 /qa 做它们擅长的事</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="82-常见反模式">8.2 常见反模式</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>反模式</th>
<th>正确做法</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>"这个简单，不需要测试"</td>
<td>再简单也走 TDD</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>"我先写代码再补测试"</td>
<td>先写的代码必须删除</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>"应该修好了"</td>
<td>不看验证输出不算修好</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>"快速修一下"</td>
<td>先 /investigate 找根因</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>"直接在 main 上改"</td>
<td>用 worktree 隔离</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>"一次性提交所有改动"</td>
<td>每个逻辑单元一个 commit</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>"代码审查太慢了跳过"</td>
<td>审查是质量保障不是负担</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h3 id="84-性能建议">8.4 性能建议</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>使用子代理并行化</strong>：独立任务用 <code>dispatching-parallel-agents</code></li>
<li><strong>按需加载技能</strong>：不要一次性调用所有技能</li>
<li><strong>利用 gstack 学习记录</strong>：<code>/learn</code> 可以避免重复踩坑</li>
<li><strong>设置 proactive 模式</strong>：让 gstack 自动建议最合适的技能</li>
</ul>
<hr>
